verdict.rationale: Airweave documents its own official MCP server, which implements the Model Context Protocol so AI assistants can search synced data. The server is also listed in the Google MCP Store, and community users compare it favorably against other MCP-server providers. missing for 10: in-depth first-party detail on the MCP tool surface and setup or transport options, plus independent hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent to the server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Airweave MCP server implements the Model Context Protocol to let AI assistants search your synced data.

Airweave MCP is part of the first set of integrations available in the Google MCP Store, enabling your coding agents to instantly search across all your synced apps and databases with zero additional setup required.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.airweave.ai/mcp-server
